description: This is a Java entity class representing a user in a financial application. It maps to a database table 'user' and includes fields for user identification and status, with annotations for ORM (Object-Relational Mapping) using JPA and Lombok.

classes.name: UserEntity
classes.description: Entity class for user data, mapped to the 'user' database table with fields for id, authId, identification, and status.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Getter for the user's ID, generated by the database.

methods.name: getAuthId
methods.description: Getter for the user's authentication identifier.

methods.name: setAuthId
methods.description: Setter for the user's authentication identifier.
